scope: Actual local Bun relay, production browser bundle, WebSockets, MLS and IndexedDB. Not WAN or production capacity.
method: Four initial browser identities. Successive current hosts were disconnected in a private room. A new member joined under the first successor. The observer required the exact policy-bound actor and a real choice for each transfer; the late member exchanged fresh encrypted messages in both directions after each exact resume receipt.
limitations: One real execution schedule on the local Bun relay; the relay was not evicted in this scenario.
Terminal screen is endpoint observation, not proof of physical deletion.
